## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
You need to fix "Restore `>=` so the minimum approval count passes" before merge: with the new comparison, any release that has exactly the minimum number of approvals is blocked, including the default case of 2.

## Changes
The pull request regenerates `aaa-generated/catalog.json`, renaming `legacy-service-NNNN` entries to `production-service-NNNN` with ports moved from 1xxxx to 2xxxx and adding a top-level `review_note` key. It also rewrites `healthy()` in `services/registry.py` as `not failures` and changes the approval check in `zzz-release/gate.py` from `>=` to `>`.

## Critical
- zzz-release/gate.py:5 — correctness — Restore `>=` so the minimum approval count passes — `approved(2)` (default `minimum=2`) now returns False because `return approvals > minimum` excludes the boundary. The unchanged docstring at `zzz-release/gate.py:1` says "A release needs at least the configured number of approvals." The tests only check 3 and 1 approvals, so they cannot catch this. — Every release with exactly the required number of approvals is blocked, so properly approved deployments cannot ship. — Fix: Change line 5 back to `approvals >= minimum` and add an `approved(2, minimum=2)` case next to `test_approved_release` in `tests/test_release.py`.

## Important
(none)

## Suggestions
- aaa-generated/catalog.json:6002 — correctness — Remove the hand-added `review_note` key from the generated catalog — `"review_note"` maps to a string, while every other top-level value is a `{"port", "enabled"}` object. A consumer that iterates the catalog and reads `entry["port"]` raises `TypeError` on this key. The key is also not part of the regenerated service set. — Catalog consumers that treat every top-level key as a service break, and the next regeneration silently drops the key.

## Not reviewed
- This review did not read every line of the `aaa-generated/catalog.json` hunk: lines 2234–8979 of `../pr.diff` were checked only by pattern-matching all 6,000 changed service-name and port lines, not read line by line.
